subject: merc
label: merc, in the place of the game's models/player/merc/merc.mdl

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/player/dmc1ns/dmc1ns.mdl, models/player/V_NVA2/V_NVA2.mdl, models/player/Renatus/Renatus.mdl: the judge does not know which
measured.contract: keeps every bone, animation, attachment and bodypart of the base

M1.reason: Against the brief's words (a mercenary in jacket and cargo trousers, boots, sunglasses, unshaven, pouches on the belt), the outline reads as a standing person in a jacket and trousers, with the 73 unit height the brief asks for. It is off in the side views (sides, LEFT and RIGHT), where the torso and head lean well forward of the feet, and the head is a plain black mass with no face shape, so the silhouette does not show the brief's face.

M2.reason: Measured height is 73.3 against the brief's 69 (6.2% over), inside the 15% line for a size the brief gives. Width and depth are 28.3 and 26.8, and the brief gives no width.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, listed down to the small ones: jacket (present, olive with yellow panels), cargo trousers (present, but no pockets modelled, so they are paint at most), two boots (present, black, in FRONT and SIDES), gear pouches on the belt (present: two at the front hips and one on the belt centre in FRONT and FRONT-LEFT), sunglasses (not visible: the head is one black mass in all ten views, so no lenses or frame are seen), and a rough unshaven face (no face at all). The sunglasses are missing in shape, so M3 is capped at 1.

M4.reason: The brief names no exact colours. The jacket is a bright, flat yellow-ochre over dark olive trousers, which reads more like a painted block than cloth. The skin region is black, not skin, because the head is a featureless black mass in every view. Each region is off from what a mercenary's clothing and face would show.

M5.reason: The brief's rough unshaven look is absent in every view: the face is black with no stubble. The sunglasses and the cargo-trouser pockets are not drawn, and the jacket and trousers are smooth with no folds, seams or wear. These are missing, not just softer.

M6.reason: In the LINE-UP (A to D) the asset (D) is the crude one: a blocky olive figure with a black head and no face, beside three detailed characters. A player would not take it for one of the game's characters, which have faces and finer shapes. Its silhouette and the jacket-and-trousers read at a glance, which is why it is 1 and not 0.

M7.reason: The front is the front: the belt pouches and the jacket's front face the front view. It stands upright on the boots, with the feet at the base of the figure, and the dive shows it is set on its origin as a standing player is.

M8.reason: Triangles are 836, far under twice the median (5,100) or the third quartile (3,341), whichever is more. SMAK's check reports no errors. Nothing in the views looks open, inside out or floating; the BELOW view shows dark shapes at the feet, which the check does not flag.

C1.reason: In the run (RUN2, 0 to 30 of 30) every part stays on the body: arms swing, legs move, and the yellow pouch stays on the torso. In the dive (DIVE_F_AKIMBO, 0 to 35 of 35), the yellow jacket panel and pouch at the shoulder and back sit off the torso from about frame 25 on and look detached in frames 30 to 35. The fault is judged from small pictures.

C2.reason: The contract measure reports that it keeps every bone, animation, attachment and bodypart of the base: a mod's code can use it by name and number, and no fault is reported.
